hooks.name: classifier-property-suite
hooks.description: When the classifier or its signals change, re-run the classifier unit and property (fast-check) tests.

action.command: pnpm vitest run tests/classify.test.ts tests/signals.test.ts tests/backoff.test.ts

hooks.name: ssrf-guard-suite
hooks.description: Any edit to the fetch layer or IP policy re-runs the SSRF guard, resolver, HTTP, limiter and backoff tests. Security first: these must stay green.

action.command: pnpm vitest run tests/guard.test.ts tests/ip.test.ts tests/http.test.ts tests/resolver.test.ts tests/limiter.test.ts tests/backoff.test.ts

hooks.name: block-env-writes
hooks.description: Refuse agent writes to .env files so secrets never land in the repo (exit 2 blocks the tool call).

hooks.name: secret-scan-on-stop
hooks.description: Before handing back, scan the working tree for keys and tokens (the pre-commit secret scan from security.md).

hooks.name: sync-spec-checklist
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, keep tasks.md, KIRO_USAGE.md and the README in step with what was actually built.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Tick it in the matching .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md only if its acceptance criteria are covered by code and a passing test. Add one dated line to KIRO_USAGE.md saying what was built and with which Kiro feature. If the README's feature list or run steps changed, update them. Never mention a personal name other than Demir.

hooks.name: dogfood-doc-links
hooks.description: On saving Markdown, scan our own docs for dead links through lychgate-mcp. Enabled once the MCP server ships (milestone 3).

action.prompt: Use the lychgate MCP tool scan_links on {{filePath}}. Report any Tombstone, Ghost or Zombie links with their suggested Wayback snapshot, and offer the patch. Do not edit the file without asking.
